variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ossian of the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith, Mabry the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: Welcome to the Drowned Lantern! Best ale on the river, and the only ale on the river! What'll ye have?

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Bandits up north, wolves in the woods... A body needs a good blade these days! Have a look.

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: Hmm? Oh, a customer. Potions on the left, scrolls on the right. Don't touch the jars.

variants.specifics: Kroth: Grubb of the Molehole tavern, Brakka the smith of Brakka's Armory, Yorla who sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Grubb
inn.text: Welcome to the Molehole! Have a mug of Mountain Brew. Puts hair on yer chest, and yer back, and yer knuckles!

arms.speaker: Brakka
arms.text: Brakka's Armory. Good steel, fair prices. What'll it be?

magic.speaker: Yorla
magic.text: Ah, a customer! With the dead walking again, everybody wants healing potions... so the price has gone up a little. Heh, heh, heh...

variants.specifics: Gloam: Bulmer of the Soggy Toad inn, Hodd the armorer, Quorra the potion-seller.

inn.speaker: Bulmer
inn.text: Welcome to the Soggy Toad, stranger! Pull up a stool. What'll it be?

arms.speaker: Hodd
arms.text: Hodd's Arms and Armor. Swords, shields, the lot. Buy something or move along, I've got work to do.

magic.speaker: Quorra
magic.text: Ahh, come in, come in! Potions, scrolls, spell books... With the Undead about, you'll be wanting plenty of everything!

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: Mungo of the Broken Pike, Brunwald the armorer, Orsolya the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Mungo
inn.text: Welcome to the Broken Pike! Try the ale -- it'll put hair on a Skeleton's chin!

arms.speaker: Brunwald
arms.text: Brunwald's Arms and Armor. Swords, shields, mail. What'll it be?

magic.speaker: Orsolya
magic.text: Ah, a customer! Potions, scrolls, spell books... With the dead walking about, I'd buy plenty, if I were you.

variants.specifics: Ostra: Mag of the Wet Herring tavern, Haldo the armourer, Zebulin the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Mag
inn.text: Sit yerself down, dearie! We got fish stew, fish pie, or fish. Heh, heh...

arms.speaker: Haldo
arms.text: Welcome to Haldo's! Swords, axes and good stout shields. How can I help you?

magic.speaker: Zebulin
magic.text: Ahh, a customer! With the dead walking about, you'll be wanting potions. Lots of potions! Zebulin has plenty.

variants.specifics: Ardoth: Bodkin of the Singed Owl inn, Krell the armorer, Olwen of the potion and scroll shop.

inn.speaker: Bodkin
inn.text: Welcome to the Singed Owl! Pull up a stool and I'll pour you somethin' warm.

arms.speaker: Krell
arms.text: Krell's Arms and Armor. Wizards don't buy from me much. Maybe you will?

magic.speaker: Olwen
magic.text: Welcome to Olwen's Potions and Scrolls! How can I help you?

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: Hobb of the Iron Kettle, Bodmar the smith, Ysmay the potion-seller.

inn.speaker: Hobb
inn.text: Shut the door, yer lettin' the snow in! Now, what'll it be? Hot cider's on the fire.

arms.speaker: Bodmar
arms.text: Welcome to Bodmar's Armory! Swords, shields, good thick armor. Can I help you?

magic.speaker: Ysmay
magic.text: Hello, hello! Potions, scrolls, spell books! I hear the Undead don't care for fire... and I just happen to have a few fire spells!

variants.specifics: Vulmar: Tobb of the Red Bucket tavern, Kraddock the armourer, and old Sibba who sells potions and scrolls.

inn.speaker: Tobb
inn.text: Sit down, sit down! The ale's cold, and in this town that's a miracle! What'll ya have?

arms.speaker: Kraddock
arms.text: Welcome to Kraddock's! Finest steel in Vulmar. Better buy now. With the forges going cold, there won't be much more of it.

magic.speaker: Sibba
magic.text: Heh, heh... A customer! Come in, come in! Potions, scrolls, spell books... just don't touch the green jar.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: Bodger keeps the Broken Wheel inn, Hargis the forge, Fizwick sells potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Bodger
inn.text: Come in, come in! Sit yerself down! The stew's hot and there's ale enough in the cellar to drown a whole army of Ogres!

arms.speaker: Hargis
arms.text: Welcome to Hargis' Forge! Swords, shields, armor. What'll it be?

magic.speaker: Fizwick
magic.text: Ahh, a customer! With Ravek about, my potions are flying off the shelves. Better buy while there's any left!

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Harl of the Rusty Plough, Brask the smith, Yselda who sells potions and spell books.

inn.speaker: Harl
inn.text: Ogres or no Ogres, the Rusty Plough stays open! What can I get fer ya?

arms.speaker: Brask
arms.text: Brask's Forge. Swords, axes, shields. Have a look.

magic.speaker: Yselda
magic.text: Greetings, Wanderer! Potions, scrolls, spell books... I have a little of everything. How can I help you?
